## Payment Policy — Verified Facts Only

- **Accepted:** Cash and major credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) for dine-in, takeout, delivery via Toast.
- **Not Accepted:** Checks are not accepted under any circumstances — no checks, no exceptions.
- **Catering:** Payment methods for catering are owner to confirm — contact for quote at (805) 439-2383 SLO or (805) 238-1851 Paso.
- **No invented prices:** Individual dish prices are not published on this marketing site per owner policy — prices are at Toast POS https://antoniaspizza.toast.site/ — deal bundles $39.99 2 XL Two-Topping + $36.99 Large Specialty Combo from owner original site are factual.
- **Direct ordering saves 15-30%:** By ordering direct via Toast, you avoid third-party commissions (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub take 15-30%) — keeps margin and customer data with the restaurant.
